findings.evidence: The declaration at line 74 is named `...eq_tsum...`, while its RHS at lines 82–84 has outer form `-Complex.log (...) * ∑' e, ...`; the adjacent established name `logDeriv_LSeries_eq_neg_tsum_vonMangoldtTransform` likewise records an outer negation.
findings.fix: Rename it to include the outer negated-log multiplication, for example `logDeriv_eulerFactor_eq_neg_log_mul_tsum_coeff_localLogDerivSeries`, and update its uses and documentation.
findings.issue: `logDeriv_eulerFactor_eq_tsum_coeff_localLogDerivSeries` suggests that the logarithmic derivative equals the coefficient `tsum`, but lines 81–84 conclude that it equals `-log N(P)` multiplied by that `tsum`. Mathlib names conclusions from the outside inward and names infix operations accordingly.

summary: One theorem name omits the outer operations on its right-hand side and therefore misdescribes the conclusion.
